inspect_bundle.description: Inspect Databricks Bundle ran, via the command, the Open Bundle Issues command, or a target switch in the panel.

properties.outcome: ok | ok_with_errors | no_bundle_file | cli_not_found | cli_not_executable | validation_timeout | invalid_bundle_shape | validation_failed | exception
properties.has_diagnostics: Failed inspections only: whether the CLI reported file diagnostics.
properties.fell_back_to_probe: Whether the requested target failed and a structural preview was shown instead.
properties.target_count: Number of targets, as a range (0, 1, 2-5, 6-20, 21-50, 51+).
properties.job_count: Number of jobs, as a range.
properties.task_count: Number of tasks, as a range.
properties.task_kinds: Databricks task type keys present, e.g. notebook_task,sql_task.
properties.issue_count: Number of inspector issues, as a range.

bundle_refreshed_on_save.description: The open inspector refreshed after a bundle-related file was saved.

properties.bundle_file: Whether the saved file was databricks.yml itself.

file_opened.description: A file was opened from the inspector.

properties.file_kind: py | ipynb | sql | yml | json | whl | jar | scala | r | other

review_summary_copied.description: The bundle review summary was copied.

graph_mode_changed.description: The graph was switched between all tasks and issues only.

job_selected.description: A different job was picked in the header.

search_result_selected.description: A task was picked from search results.

issue_item_selected.description: An item in the issues panel was clicked.

extension_uninstalled.description: Sent once by the vscode:uninstall hook, only if the extension last recorded that usage telemetry was enabled.

commonProperties.common.*: Added by VS Code's TelemetryLogger: extension version, VS Code version, OS, session ID, UI kind, remote type. The VS Code machine ID is removed.
commonProperties.common.appname: Host editor name, e.g. Visual Studio Code or Cursor.
